summary: Build a Smart Queue & Feedback Management System: users join a digital queue, track their position, and submit feedback for services.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimal modern logo mark featuring a queue/ticket motif (sqfm-logo.dim_256x256.png)
- Wide hero illustration showing people in an organized line with abstract UI elements, warm neutral palette with teal/orange accents (sqfm-hero.dim_1200x600.png)
- Simple empty-state illustration for ‘No active queue’ (sqfm-empty-state.dim_512x512.png)

existing_features.title: Build a user-facing frontend that lets users: (1) select a service, (2) join the queue, (3) view live-refreshed queue status (position + status), and (4) leave the queue.
Build a user-facing feedback UI: users can select a service, submit a rating and optional comment, and see a confirmation/receipt state after successful submission.
Add an admin/staff frontend area to manage queues and review feedback: choose a service, view current queue entries, advance/serve next, mark no-show/cancel, clear queue, and view feedback list.
Apply a cohesive, creative visual theme across the frontend (colors, typography, spacing, and components) suitable for a “service queue” product, avoiding blue/purple as primary brand colors.
Add required static generated images to the frontend and render them in the UI (store under frontend/public/assets/generated).

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement smart digital queuing (join queue and track position/status)
Implement feedback management (collect and submit feedback for services)

Implement backend data models and APIs for a digital queue: create/list services, join a service queue, leave a queue, fetch a user’s current queue status (position + state), and fetch the current queue snapshot for a service.
Implement backend staff/admin queue controls for a service: advance to next customer (serve current), mark an entry as no-show/cancelled, and reset/clear a service queue.
Implement backend feedback collection APIs: submit feedback for a service (rating + free-text comment), and list feedback entries per service (admin/staff view).
